overall_goal: Serve a bowl of soup and prepare to eat it.

goals.description: Clear counter space and retrieve a ladle
goals.rationale: The person moves items out of the way to place the bowl and then fetches a ladle from the drawer.
The person uses the ladle to scoop and pour soup from the pot into the bowl, stirring it in the process.

goals.description: Dry hands and adjust the oven temperature
goals.rationale: The person takes a brief pause from serving to dry their hands and adjust the preheating oven.

goals.description: Retrieve a spoon and carry the served soup
goals.rationale: The person opens a drawer to get a spoon, places it in the bowl, and carries the meal away to eat.
